Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results. While the search query "Alain Robbe-Grillet spouse" returned a result showing "Simone de Beauvoir" under the "Spouse" field, this was a hallucination or error in the search engine's snippet (or the agent misread the snippet which likely contained conflicting info or a joke about a character in his novels, as Simone de Beauvoir was Robbe-Grillet's lover/friend but not his wife; his wife was actually Monique de Saint-Étienne). The agent accepted this incorrect information as fact without verifying it against the Wikipedia page content which would likely clarify the actual marital status, leading to the wrong final answer.
